description: This file implements a DRM content converter with session management, MIME header parsing, encryption, and signature generation, specifically for forward lock DRM in Android. It handles parsing of MIME headers, boundary detection, base64 and binary data encryption, and session lifecycle management.

classes.name: FwdLockConv_Session
classes.description: Holds per-session state including parser state, MIME headers, encryption keys, and cryptographic contexts.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_AcquireSession
methods.description: Allocates and returns an unused session ID.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_IsValidSession
methods.description: Checks if a session ID is valid and active.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_DeriveKeys
methods.description: Derives encryption and signing keys from the session key.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_OpenSession
methods.description: Initializes a new DRM conversion session, generating keys and setting initial parser state.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_ConvertData
methods.description: Processes input data, parsing headers, encrypting content, and updating signatures.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_CloseSession
methods.description: Finalizes signatures, outputs header/footer info, and cleans up session.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_ConvertOpenFile
methods.description: Converts a file stream by reading, processing, and writing DRM-protected content.
